Name: Abishag, Shunammite
Summary: Abishag, a fair young Shunammite, was brought to cherish the aged David in his last days, and after his death Adonijah's request for her as wife exposed his renewed claim to the throne.
KeyStory: Abishag cherishes David and becomes Adonijah's pretext.
RelatedPeople: King David; King Solomon; Adonijah, Son of Haggith
LifeLesson: Even a quiet servant can become the occasion that exposes a hidden ambition.
